{{Top|leg}}
An '''air ambulance''' was a heavy [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] developed by [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]]. It had a cockpit with room for three [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and a large rear compartment that carried a floating [[Shock-cot/Legends|shock-cot]], computerized medical monitors, and two [[MicroMed Droid]]s.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
